scripts.build: pnpm --filter @discord-mock/web build && pnpm --filter @discord-mock/server build && pnpm --filter @discord-mock/client-js build && pnpm --filter @discord-mock/level-bot build
scripts.lint: biome lint --error-on-warnings apps packages/client-js scripts biome.json tsconfig.base.json package.json .vscode/settings.json && pnpm --filter @discord-mock/level-bot lint
scripts.check: pnpm check:ts && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint
scripts.check:py: uv run --project packages/client-py ruff check packages/client-py && uv run --project packages/client-py ruff format --check packages/client-py
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @discord-mock/web test && pnpm --filter @discord-mock/server test && pnpm --filter @discord-mock/client-js test
scripts.lint:py: uv run --project packages/client-py ruff check packages/client-py
